ops.old: Brush flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar. Grill until blistered. Tear into pieces and serve with a bowl of hummus and a bowl of labneh drizzled with more oil. Market stall style.
ops.new: Brush flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with sumac and sesame. Grill until blistered. Tear into pieces and serve with a bowl of hummus and a bowl of labneh drizzled with more oil. Market stall style.

ops.old: Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and za'atar, grilled until blistered, torn and served with hummus and labneh.
ops.new: Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and sumac and sesame, grilled until blistered, torn and served with hummus and labneh.

ops.old: Best grilled just before serving; brush with oil and sprinkle with za'atar up to 2 hours ahead
ops.new: Best grilled just before serving; brush with oil and sprinkle with sumac and sesame up to 2 hours ahead

ops.old: Brush the flatbreads with oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar.
ops.new: Brush the flatbreads with oil and sprinkle generously with sumac and sesame.
